video_title: Wolves draft, trades...and KAT | The Jon Krawczynski Show

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' impact on the Timberwolves' playoff success
quotes.quote: Karl-Anthony Towns is a champion. He was an integral part of what the Knicks did and to see him having a chance to raise that trophy, to hug his fiancee and his dad, and think about all of the stuff that he's had to deal with, all of the nonsense and suggestions of softness, he's overcome all of that. He matured his game, he got himself to a place where he was an incredibly important piece of one of the best playoff teams of all time.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves' playoff performance shows they can compete without a superteam
quotes.excerpt: It's not like they built a superteam out of established superstars. They just played really good basketball.
quotes.quote: The Wolves were one of the most dominant playoff teams in history and they played brilliantly together. They played great defense, they do so many things well, but it's not like they built a superteam out of established superstars. They just played really good basketball. I almost feel like that gives the Wolves some hope.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves unlikely to keep the 28th pick in the draft
quotes.excerpt: I would just be surprised if they stay at 28 and pick.
quotes.quote: I would just be surprised if they stay at 28 and pick. Generally speaking, I don't know that they're going to draft a rookie that is going to come in and play and contribute quite a bit. I see two options: trade the number 28 pick as part of a package for a veteran player, or if you get down to 28, maybe you trade down back into the second round and pick up some future assets.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Unlikely that the Timberwolves will trade for Kyrie Irving
quotes.excerpt: I don't think so anymore, Jim. We talked a lot about this earlier in this summer.
quotes.quote: I don't think so anymore, Jim. We talked a lot about this earlier in this summer. There's been more and more signs coming out of Dallas that Kyrie is going to stay there. The Mavericks want Kyrie to play alongside Cooper Flagg, that Kyrie really enjoys being in Dallas, and that he wants to stay there. It did seem like he has found some comfort and tranquility there, so that makes sense. While I believe that if the Wolves were going to trade for Kyrie Irving, yes, maybe it would be Julius Randle and a number one pick and something else to get Kyrie, that is looking more and more unlikely at this point.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves exploring trade options for a third team to acquire Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: One thing that I'm starting to explore more is the possibility of not them trading for Giannis.
quotes.quote: One thing that I'm starting to explore more is the possibility of not them trading for Giannis, but of getting in as a third team where Giannis goes somewhere else and pieces come to Minnesota. There's been a lot of heat about Boston getting back into the Giannis sweepstakes. If they do make that happen, Jaylen Brown likely goes elsewhere. I don't think Jaylen Brown comes here with his contract situation, but what if Derrick White is the guy that comes to Minnesota in some sort of three-team Giannis thing?

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Chicago Bulls hire Thiago Splitter as head coach
quotes.excerpt: The Chicago Bulls have hired Thiago Splitter to be their head coach.
quotes.quote: The Chicago Bulls have hired Thiago Splitter to be their head coach. Mike Budenholzer is reporting that. Splitter coached the Portland Trail Blazers last season and Mike Budenholzer is in the running for the Portland job as well. So with Splitter out, I do think there is a really good chance for Mike Budenholzer in Portland.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves' arena situation in downtown Minneapolis
quotes.excerpt: They have all but decided that the site for a new arena is going to be downtown Minneapolis.
quotes.quote: They have all but decided that the site for a new arena is going to be downtown Minneapolis. We have seen plenty of other teams and other markets explore suburban sites, the Atlanta Braves being kind of one of the biggest most recent teams to go outside of the downtown area and have a lot of success. But Matt was very forthright with us and saying that they want to be downtown, that they believe that the leadership, the government officials want it to happen downtown.
